text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Homare-san's beauty is black-hearted, isn't it? Of course it's a compliment. It's impressive that he doesn't look away mischievously, calmly entering the other person's pocket, and gradually entangling them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホマレさんの美しいところ、
それは
腹黒さだね。
もちろん褒め言葉さ。
いたずらに裏の顔を振りかざさず、
穏やかに相手の懐に入り
徐々にからめとっていく手管は見事だよね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: But at the same time, that's a flaw. I mean, he's scary, isn't he? He's even more scary than the rude, violent villain. He may be attractive, but you have to be careful with him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも同時に
それが欠点でもあるかな。
だって
怖いよね？　
あの人。
粗野で乱暴な悪役よりも
よっぽど恐怖を感じるよ。
魅力的な人物だけど
付き合いは慎重にならないとね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Kaya's beauty is the strength of his fighting spirit. I don't understand why he's always looking for a fight, but his foolish, honest passion is pure beauty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カヤさんの美しいところといえば、
闘争心の強さだね。
常にたぎるようなケンカを求める姿勢は
理解から遠いけど、
その愚直なまでの熱さは、
純粋な美であるといえるね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Then again, I don’t really want you to get involved in any violence. You have handsome features, a well-proportioned frame, and it hurts my heart to see something beautiful get hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっとも、
ボクとしては
あまり荒事に関わってほしくないんだけどね。
端正な顔立ちに
均整のとれた体躯、
美しいものが傷付くのは
心が痛むからね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Inori-chan's beauty is the energy hidden within her small body. Not only does she have the unique power of the dragons, but she also has the ambition to become an organization. I think there's a chance she'll eventually do something big.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イノリちゃんの美しさは
小さな体に秘めたエネルギーだね。
ドラゴン族特有の力だけでなく、
組織で成り上がろうという野心もある。
いずれ大きな事を成す可能性もあるんじゃないかな。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Still, the current situation is pretty timid, so it looks like we'll have a long way to go. It's not a bad idea to be a loser mascot character, so depending on the situation, we might be able to turn around and extend our reach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
現状は臆病なところが強く出てるから、
先は長そうだね。
ヘタレ属性のマスコットキャラ
というのも悪くないから、
場合によっては方向転換して
こっちを伸ばすのも
ありかもしれないね。
